authorOverrides.summary: Digital/mobile rule: legendary rewards are independent uniform random selections with replacement from the four legendary card types; sea legendary places grant one such card plus the named place card on first visit, while Atlantia, Adia and Skull do so only on first military conquest; Cartographic Chamber expeditions exist only for the seven sea legendary places and grant one random treasure.
